correctness.rationale: Every real bounded-variation input pair has a pointwise secant-slope mask for positive-part activation, A_theta=I+diag(theta)(Q_r-I). The absolutely summable jump decomposition reduces total-variation gain to step columns. Their two side ramps yield E_r=2 sum over nonadjacent falling transitions at weights 1,...,r-1, maximal 2 floor(r^2/4) per wing, hence 1+4 floor(r^2/4)/(2r+1). The finite principal matrix of I-Q_r is strictly positive definite from its adjacent-edge energy and realizes any optimal sign pattern on support of Q_rH-H; nonnegative finite-variation attaining pairs follow after adding a constant. Check r=1 exactly 1, r=2 9/5; no quotient at constant differences. Independent rational binary-wing enumeration for r=1..6 agreed with predicted constants. The verifier source was inspected, not taken as a proof or uncritically as a PASS.
